newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers rise, but capped by competition.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers rise, but capped by competition.

text.p: Rotterdam fuel oil bunkers rose very slightly on Thursday as barges rose but competition for sales was fierce, dealers said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at around $84 fob by most suppliers, although some were prepared to deal at below $83, barely any mark-up over barge quotes.
"A couple of people have gambled with these low offers. You can't pick product up for that little," one supplier said.
Total ARA demand reached about 20,000 tonnes. The sales largely went to majors and a handful of independents who were prepared to sell low.
Hamburg prices dipped by $1 a tonne to $90 fob, making the German port slightly more competitive with Rotterdam. The result was an increase in enquiries in the morning at least.
Mediterranean prices were barely changed. Some ports saw reasonable volumes in the morning, but most were quiet by the afternoon.
Some suppliers said the Greek Easter, beginning on Friday, had already removed a number of buyers.
